name: shifting-mirage-no-class-bonus-costs-printed-three
notes: Shifting Mirage (hmjr33ijq6, printed reserve 3): "[Class Bonus] This card costs 1 less to activate." Negative case: the champion is patched to Diana, Duskstalker (UMBRA so the card is playable, but class RANGER, not ASSASSIN, and no Tristan lineage), so neither the Class Bonus discount nor the [Tristan Bonus] Ominous Shadow applies. The caster must pay all THREE reserve cards (still unresolved after two, resolved after the third: memory 3, hand 8 - 1 - 3 = 4); the opponent declines the (2) payment and Diana gains STEALTH; no token is summoned.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] This card costs 1 less to activate. (inactive: no discount)
[Tristan Bonus] Summon an Ominous Shadow token. (inactive: no token)
